title: Adaptive Calibration in Non-Stationary Environments
abstract: arXiv:2605.11490v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Making calibrated online predictions is a central challenge in modern AI systems. Much of the existing literature focuses on fully adversarial environments where outcomes may be arbitrary, leading to conservative algorithms that can perform suboptimally in more benign settings, such as when outcomes are nearly stationary. This gap raises a natural question: can we design online prediction algorithms whose calibration error automatically adapts to the degree of non-stationarity in the environment, smoothly interpolating between i.i.d. and adversarial regimes? We answer this question in the affirmative and develop a suite of algorithms that achieve adaptive calibration guarantees under multiple calibration measures. translated_title: 非平稳环境中的自适应校准
translated_abstract: 在现代人工智能系统中，做出经过校准的在线预测是一个核心挑战。现有文献大多关注完全对抗性的环境，其中结果可能是任意的，这导致算法过于保守，在更温和的环境中（例如结果近乎平稳的情形下）可能表现次优。这一空白引出了一个自然的问题：我们能否设计出这样的在线预测算法，使其校准误差能够自动适应环境的非平稳程度，并在独立同分布（i.i.d.）情形与对抗性情形之间平滑过渡？我们对这一问题给出了肯定的回答，并开发了一套在多种校准指标下均能实现自适应校准保证的算法。具体而言，设 T 为轮数，W 为环境中未知的独立同分布段数，C∈[0,T] 为另一个未知的非平稳性度量，其定义为最小的 ℓ1 偏差……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了能够自动适应环境非平稳程度的在线预测校准算法，其校准误差可在独立同分布与对抗性两种情形之间平滑过渡，并在多种校准指标下提供了自适应保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops online prediction algorithms whose calibration error automatically adapts to the degree of non-stationarity, smoothly interpolating between i.i.d. and adversarial regimes while achieving adaptive calibration guarantees under multiple calibration measures.
